description: This Java class defines the data structure for provisioning criteria definitions within the Fineract project. It includes fields such as category details, age range, provisioning percentage, and related account information. The class implements comparison and provides a static factory method for creating template instances.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaDefinitionData
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) representing provisioning criteria, including category info, age range, provisioning percentage, and account details. It supports comparison based on its ID and chainable setters.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ProvisioningCriteriaDefinitionData with specified category ID and name.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Defines comparison logic for instances based on the ID field, used for sorting purposes.
